description: This file defines the EmailService class, which provides methods for queuing emails and templated emails using an underlying Redis queue, template engine, and configuration.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Service class for handling email queuing and templating.

methods.name: queueEmail
methods.description: Queues an email message with specified subject, recipients, body, and optional attachment path.

methods.name: queueTemplatedEmail
methods.description: Renders an email body from a template and variables, then queues it for sending.
